statement.hypotheses: E is an elliptic curve over a finite field F_q; q is a prime power.
statement.point_count: Full elliptic curve group, including point at infinity; p137 identifies it as one more than the affine Weierstrass solution count.

current_use.primary_locator: Hasse bound for an elliptic curve over F_p
current_use.match: Set q=p_j at the already specified smooth reduction. The bound gives cardinality=p_j+1+O(sqrt(p_j)), hence p_j+O(sqrt(p_j)). It does not bound an arbitrary point order below by p_j; the separate group/order-identification hypothesis must remain. No claim that every point order has this size.
current_use.excluded: Bad reduction and arbitrary proper subgroup order are not covered by this theorem.
